name: WeMM-Ecom-35B-A3B Q5_K_M (Tencent WeChat Vision, e-commerce multimodal fine-tune of Qwen3.5-35B-A3B, MoE, hybrid thinking, vision)

files.note: bartowski's imatrix Q5_K_M (Tencent's own GGUF is a single 19.7 GB quant)

notes: Tencent WeChat Vision's WeMM-Ecom-35B-A3B: Qwen3.5-35B-A3B post-trained for e-commerce image understanding (product attributes, moderation, OCR, retrieval, grounding) while keeping general skills; hybrid thinking, 262k context, text / image / video input. ~3B active. No MTP head in the release (mtp_num_hidden_layers 0), so no MTP drafting. Same architecture as qwen3.6-35b-a3b otherwise. Sampling: generation_config top_k 20, top_p 0.95, with temperature 0.7 as the other Qwen3.5 / 3.6 presets. ts = A4500,V100.
